title: Material Blend 4-Mix Duo #11 (나비날개비늘+드래곤비늘+크리스탈+보태니컬 / UV네온+금박+이레즈미+흑요암금)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each with her own multi-material blended body.

Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft, diagonal or curving rather than a straight line, the materials interweaving and overlapping gradually across an irregular blended border a few inches wide, elements of each scattered into the neighbouring zone, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
#1: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

#2: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, early 30s goddess, wide hip narrow physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — hips so impossibly wide extending beyond frame creating the most extreme hip-to-waist ratio ever, waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, upper body slim emphasizing the dramatic hip explosion, silver-white natural hair swept into a high sculpted crown — her body carries 4 different materials at once, each claiming roughly an equal irregular organic share of her body rather than any straight line, zones arranged diagonally and asymmetrically. Wherever any two zones meet, the boundary is soft, diagonal or curving rather than a straight line, the materials interweaving and overlapping gradually across an irregular blended border a few inches wide, elements of each scattered into the neighbouring zone, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme wide hip narrow silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive zone specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
#2: extreme platform heels/boots blending the relevant materials at her feet, extra long nails each matching whichever zone that hand falls in.

Environment: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient.
All: Extreme macro detail on every material and every blended transition. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
